nodes.label: Strategy
nodes.question: What potential solution is suggested for reducing total energy consumption in buildings on the Sichuan Plateau?
nodes.answer: Fully utilizing renewable energy sources is suggested as a solution to reduce the total energy consumption of buildings.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Smart cities|Smart buildings|Renewable energy integration in buildings_qna_001
nodes.question: How has the incorporation of renewable energies in cities impacted the costs of electricity production?
nodes.answer: The incorporation of renewable energies in cities has reduced the costs of electricity production due to the affordability of products like solar panels and batteries, which have become more cost-effective with the integration of smart technologies in cities.
